title: Ulla, Son of Rabbi Zakkai
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Yuchasin cites this name from Chullin 52a. Hyman says it is indeed the reading of Rabbenu Gershom, Tosafot under Neekra and the Soncino printing. The ordinary reading, however, is “Ulla said: Ben Zakkai said,” derived from Maharshal’s emendation. Hyman therefore considers Seder HaDorot’s criticism of Yuchasin unwarranted.

notes.text: The alternatives describe different structures: Ulla, son of Zakkai, or Ulla reporting Ben Zakkai. Hyman sides with Yuchasin against Seder HaDorot’s criticism.
The consulted Tosafot and Rabbenu Gershom texts name Ulla as son of Zakkai. The consulted Gemara gives Ulla and Ben Zakkai as separate speakers. The Soncino and Maharshal attributions follow Hyman.
